description: This PHP class 'ProjectAdminUserRole' defines a specific user role for project administrators within the OrangeHRM system. It manages access to employees, projects, and customers based on permissions, utilizing traits for customer and project services. The class extends an abstract user role class, providing methods to retrieve accessible entity IDs for the role.

classes.name: ProjectAdminUserRole
classes.description: Represents a project administrator user role with methods to determine accessible entities based on permissions.

methods.name: getAccessibleIdsForEntity
methods.description: Returns IDs of accessible entities (employees, projects, customers) based on entity type and permissions.

methods.name: getAccessibleEmployeeIds
methods.description: Retrieves employee IDs accessible to the project admin, conditioned on specific permissions.

methods.name: getAccessibleProjectIds
methods.description: Retrieves project IDs accessible to the project admin.

methods.name: getAccessibleCustomerIds
methods.description: Retrieves customer IDs accessible to the project admin.
